title: Iterations that consume no input are bounded: a huge empty repetition is true or a ResourceLimit error
description: ((){20000}){200000} asks for four thousand million iterations of a group that matches the empty string. The empty subject matches it, so a processor that does not perform the idle iterations answers true; one that performs them meets its match-cost limit, and one that refuses the pattern for its bounds (200,000 is above 65,535, and the product above 1,000,000) says so. Each is a ResourceLimit error or the value true; what no processor may do is run unbounded, or answer false.
